Hi, I'm Arun — a full-stack engineer with five years of experience building products that scale.
I've worked on systems serving over thirty million customers, and I love building things that actually matter to people.
My stack spans React, Node.js, TypeScript, and cloud infrastructure on GCP. I'm comfortable across the entire stack — from pixel-perfect frontends to distributed backend systems.
I thrive in environments where ownership and impact go hand in hand. I've led cross-functional features, mentored engineers, and shipped products used by real people every day.
Outside of work, I'm into game development, guitar, and building side projects that push what's possible on the web.
